title: Penalties
bodyText: . Any employer found in violation of section 388-51 shall be subject to a fine of no less than $250 nor more than $2,500 to be collected by the director and the fine shall not be suspended. Each violation shall constitute a separate offense. Amounts so collected by the director shall be paid into the general fund.
bodyHtml: §388-52  Penalties.  Any employer found in violation of section 388-51 shall be subject to a fine of no less than $250 nor more than $2,500 to be collected by the director and the fine shall not be suspended.  Each violation shall constitute a separate offense.  Amounts so collected by the director shall be paid into the general fund. [L 1987, c 169, §2; am L 2020, c 44, §12]
